Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12351 of 2023

Applicant :- Dharmendra Kumar Yadav
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ishan Baghel
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ishan Baghel, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Rao Narendra Singh, learned
A.G.A.-I for the State and perused the records.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
382 of 2022, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B I.P.C. and Section 66 D of Information
Technology Act, registered at Police Station Hazratganj, District Lucknow.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 04.11.2022 against Uptron Powertronics Limited and Kuldeep Singh besides some unknown persons alleging commission of illegalities in NEET Examination, 2021 by making unauthorized interference in the original data base and official website of Ayush Department.

The applicant has been implicated in the present case as it came to light during investigation that he is brother of one Dr. Vijay Yadav, the Chairman and Director of K.V.S. College and Dr. Vijay Ayurvedic Medical College, Hospital &

Dr. Vijay Ayurvedic Medical College, Hospital &
Dharmendra Kumar Yadav vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that eight co-accused persons have already been granted bail in the present case and the copies of their bail orders have been annexed with the affidavit filed on behalf of the applicant.

The bail application of co-accused Dr. Vijay Yadav had been rejected by this court but the aforesaid co-accused person has also been granted bail by means of an order dated 28.08.2023, passed by Hon'ble Supreme Court in S.L.P. (Criminal) No.7486 of 2023.

One more co-accused Harsh Vardhan Tiwari @ Sonal has also been granted bail by means of an order dated 26.10.2023, passed by this court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9793 of 2023.
5.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9793 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.

The applicant's criminal history of one case bearing F.I.R. No.163of 2022 under Sections 419/420 I.P.C. & Section 6/10 of U.P. Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 1998, Police Rohaniya, District Varanasi has been disclosed in para 41 of the affidavit, in which the applicant has been granted anticipatory bail by this court by means of an order dated 11.08.2022 passed Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No.6093 of 2022.

entities.text: U.P. Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 1998
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No.6093 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. As eight co-accused persons have already been granted bail in the present case including co-accused Dr. Vijay Yadav and keeping in view the fact that that the applicant is languishing in jail since 01.12.2022 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant also on bail in the aforesaid crime on the ground of parity.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
